nodes.label: SPAN-01
nodes.function_definition: Span (Bridges gaps between separated points or parties)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy to make first contact between two isolated parties who don't yet know they need each other. Span-01 is the cold introduction that becomes the only route through.

nodes.label: SPAN-02
nodes.function_definition: Span (Bridges gaps between separated points or parties)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy when an existing channel is fraying under load. Span-02 adds redundancy to a bridge so a single point of failure can't sever the whole connection.

nodes.label: SPAN-03
nodes.function_definition: Span (Bridges gaps between separated points or parties)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy when the direct path is compromised or blocked. Span-03 finds the detour and makes it feel like the plan all along.

nodes.label: SPAN-04
nodes.function_definition: Span (Bridges gaps between separated points or parties)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy to force two reluctant sides into the same room. Span-04 turns a soft ask into a connection neither party can afford to ignore.

nodes.label: SPAN-05
nodes.function_definition: Span (Bridges gaps between separated points or parties)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy mid-crossing, when movement across the gap risks stalling. Span-05 keeps throughput steady so nothing is stranded halfway.

nodes.label: SPAN-06
nodes.function_definition: Span (Bridges gaps between separated points or parties)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy once the bridge has served its purpose and lingering ties would only create liability. Span-06 disconnects without leaving a trace of dependency behind.

nodes.label: SPAN-07
nodes.function_definition: Span (Bridges gaps between separated points or parties)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy when both sides must act on the same beat or the connection collapses. Span-07 is the handshake that synchronizes timing across the gap.

nodes.label: SPAN-08
nodes.function_definition: Span (Bridges gaps between separated points or parties)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy when a working connection needs more capacity, not a new one. Span-08 widens existing throughput instead of building a second bridge.

nodes.label: SPAN-09
nodes.function_definition: Span (Bridges gaps between separated points or parties)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy when the crossing needs to exist for the few who know, and no one else. Span-09 builds a bridge that reads as empty space to anyone not carrying the key.

nodes.label: SPAN-10
nodes.function_definition: Span (Bridges gaps between separated points or parties)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy to make a hidden route common knowledge, on purpose. Span-10 turns a private crossing into public infrastructure once secrecy stops paying off.

nodes.label: BREAK-01
nodes.function_definition: Break (Disrupts or ends an existing pattern)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy the first crack in a system that looks unbreakable. Break-01 doesn't need force — it needs the one flaw that makes everyone else start looking for more.

nodes.label: BREAK-02
nodes.function_definition: Break (Disrupts or ends an existing pattern)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy to harden the line that's already stopping a runaway pattern. Break-02 isn't the disruption itself — it's making sure the disruption holds and doesn't get walked back.

nodes.label: BREAK-03
nodes.function_definition: Break (Disrupts or ends an existing pattern)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy when a fracture is already happening but heading somewhere worse. Break-03 steers the damage toward an outcome you can actually use.

nodes.label: BREAK-04
nodes.function_definition: Break (Disrupts or ends an existing pattern)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy for scorched-earth exits and the permanent, recursive dismantling of entrenched structures. Break-04 turns a small fissure into a compounding systemic collapse.

nodes.label: BREAK-05
nodes.function_definition: Break (Disrupts or ends an existing pattern)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy immediately after the initial break, before drift turns a clean cut into an uncontrolled spiral. Break-05 locks the disruption at the size you intended.

nodes.label: BREAK-06
nodes.function_definition: Break (Disrupts or ends an existing pattern)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy to finish a pattern completely, not just interrupt it. Break-06 clears the field so nothing is left to reassert itself later.

nodes.label: BREAK-07
nodes.function_definition: Break (Disrupts or ends an existing pattern)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy when a pattern spans multiple actors who all need to feel the break at once. Break-07 makes the reset simultaneous, so no one can quietly opt out of it.

nodes.label: BREAK-08
nodes.function_definition: Break (Disrupts or ends an existing pattern)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy to turn a quiet fracture into a visible one. Break-08 exposes the hairline cracks a system was hoping to keep off the record.

nodes.label: BREAK-09
nodes.function_definition: Break (Disrupts or ends an existing pattern)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy when the break has to look like decay, not sabotage. Break-09 disrupts from inside the pattern so the shift reads as natural erosion.

nodes.label: BREAK-10
nodes.function_definition: Break (Disrupts or ends an existing pattern)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy when denial is the only thing keeping a broken system standing. Break-10 forces the room to acknowledge what already failed.

nodes.label: FUSE-01
nodes.function_definition: Fuse (Binds separate elements into one)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy to make the first connection between components that have never had to rely on each other. Fuse-01 is the tack weld — small, but it's what everything else gets built on.

nodes.label: FUSE-02
nodes.function_definition: Fuse (Binds separate elements into one)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy where a bond exists but hasn't been tested under real load yet. Fuse-02 reinforces the seam before pressure finds the weak point for you.

nodes.label: FUSE-03
nodes.function_definition: Fuse (Binds separate elements into one)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy when a bond is holding the wrong two things together. Fuse-03 doesn't break it — it reconfigures what's on each end until the connection actually works.

nodes.label: FUSE-04
nodes.function_definition: Fuse (Binds separate elements into one)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy when partial buy-in isn't enough and the moment calls for total, forced unity. Fuse-04 collapses the space between components until there's no seam left to exploit.

nodes.label: FUSE-05
nodes.function_definition: Fuse (Binds separate elements into one)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy when a bonded system is under stress and threatening to shake apart. Fuse-05 keeps the whole assembly coherent through the turbulence.

nodes.label: FUSE-06
nodes.function_definition: Fuse (Binds separate elements into one)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy when components need to separate without damaging each other on the way out. Fuse-06 dissolves the bond along its original seams, not a jagged tear.

nodes.label: FUSE-07
nodes.function_definition: Fuse (Binds separate elements into one)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy once separate parts are bonded and need to move as a single body. Fuse-07 is the shared rhythm that makes a joined system act like it was never two things.

nodes.label: FUSE-08
nodes.function_definition: Fuse (Binds separate elements into one)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy to convert a merger into leverage. Fuse-08 takes a stable bond and pushes its combined output past what either side could produce alone.

nodes.label: FUSE-09
nodes.function_definition: Fuse (Binds separate elements into one)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy when an alliance needs the benefits of unity without the appearance of one. Fuse-09 binds two parties so completely that the bond itself disappears from view.

nodes.label: FUSE-10
nodes.function_definition: Fuse (Binds separate elements into one)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy to make an alliance official. Fuse-10 puts a bonded relationship on the record, on purpose, as proof of where loyalties now sit.

nodes.label: RELAY-01
nodes.function_definition: Relay (Carries information from one point to another)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy to wake up a network that's gone dormant. Relay-01 is the first ping that gets everyone else moving again.

nodes.label: RELAY-02
nodes.function_definition: Relay (Carries information from one point to another)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy on a message that can't afford to degrade in transit. Relay-02 armors the signal so distance and noise can't corrupt it.

nodes.label: RELAY-03
nodes.function_definition: Relay (Carries information from one point to another)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy when the intended recipient isn't the right one anymore. Relay-03 reroutes the information before it lands somewhere it can be misused.

nodes.label: RELAY-04
nodes.function_definition: Relay (Carries information from one point to another)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy when silence is being used as an excuse. Relay-04 turns a routine update into a demand that can't be left unread.

nodes.label: RELAY-05
nodes.function_definition: Relay (Carries information from one point to another)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy across a long or noisy channel where the signal risks drifting off message. Relay-05 keeps every hop aligned with the original intent.

nodes.label: RELAY-06
nodes.function_definition: Relay (Carries information from one point to another)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy to shut a channel down without leaving it half-open. Relay-06 lets a transmission system power all the way off, cleanly, once it's no longer needed.

nodes.label: RELAY-07
nodes.function_definition: Relay (Carries information from one point to another)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy across multiple channels that need to deliver the same message at the same moment. Relay-07 is the master clock that keeps every relay point in time.

nodes.label: RELAY-08
nodes.function_definition: Relay (Carries information from one point to another)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy when a message needs to reach further than its original audience. Relay-08 is raw reach — the same signal, carried past the range it started with.

nodes.label: RELAY-09
nodes.function_definition: Relay (Carries information from one point to another)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy for information that has to move without leaving a readable trail. Relay-09 carries the message through channels that don't log what passed through them.

nodes.label: RELAY-10
nodes.function_definition: Relay (Carries information from one point to another)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy to settle a dispute over what was actually said. Relay-10 puts the unedited message back in front of everyone, source intact.

nodes.label: ANCHOR-01
nodes.function_definition: Anchor (Stabilizes a structure against pressure)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy before anything else is built. Anchor-01 sets the one fixed point everything downstream will be measured against.

nodes.label: ANCHOR-02
nodes.function_definition: Anchor (Stabilizes a structure against pressure)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy when a stable structure is about to face pressure it wasn't originally built for. Anchor-02 reinforces the foundation before the stress test, not during it.

nodes.label: ANCHOR-03
nodes.function_definition: Anchor (Stabilizes a structure against pressure)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy when the current foundation is sound but poorly placed. Anchor-03 relocates the grounding point to where it can actually hold weight.

nodes.label: ANCHOR-04
nodes.function_definition: Anchor (Stabilizes a structure against pressure)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy when collapse is imminent and half-measures won't hold. Anchor-04 throws maximum resistance at the failure point, whatever the cost to flexibility.

nodes.label: ANCHOR-05
nodes.function_definition: Anchor (Stabilizes a structure against pressure)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy in the middle of active volatility. Anchor-05 is the structure staying upright while everything around it is still moving.

nodes.label: ANCHOR-06
nodes.function_definition: Anchor (Stabilizes a structure against pressure)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy when a structure has outlived its foundation and needs to be freed to reset. Anchor-06 releases support on purpose, not through failure.

nodes.label: ANCHOR-07
nodes.function_definition: Anchor (Stabilizes a structure against pressure)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy across a system with more than one point of stability. Anchor-07 synchronizes every stabilizing force so none of them is fighting the others.

nodes.label: ANCHOR-08
nodes.function_definition: Anchor (Stabilizes a structure against pressure)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy once stability is no longer the ceiling but the floor. Anchor-08 uses a secure foundation to support more weight than the structure was originally rated for.

nodes.label: ANCHOR-09
nodes.function_definition: Anchor (Stabilizes a structure against pressure)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy when visible support would invite a challenge to it. Anchor-09 keeps a structure grounded without advertising what's holding it up.

nodes.label: ANCHOR-10
nodes.function_definition: Anchor (Stabilizes a structure against pressure)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy after a period of doubt about whether something would hold. Anchor-10 makes the stabilizing force visible again, on purpose, to rebuild confidence.

nodes.label: QUIET-01
nodes.function_definition: Quiet (Exerts subtle, decisive influence)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy the first nudge no one will remember as the start of anything. Quiet-01 shifts direction before the room even knows a decision was being made.

nodes.label: QUIET-02
nodes.function_definition: Quiet (Exerts subtle, decisive influence)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy to keep a quiet influence from being noticed and corrected. Quiet-02 reapplies just enough pressure to hold the course without drawing attention to it.

nodes.label: QUIET-03
nodes.function_definition: Quiet (Exerts subtle, decisive influence)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy when an outcome needs to change without anyone pointing to the moment it changed. Quiet-03 redirects the result while leaving the process looking untouched.

nodes.label: QUIET-04
nodes.function_definition: Quiet (Exerts subtle, decisive influence)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy when subtlety alone won't move an entrenched resistance. Quiet-04 raises the quiet pressure until it overrides opposition without ever becoming visible as pressure.

nodes.label: QUIET-05
nodes.function_definition: Quiet (Exerts subtle, decisive influence)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy in a volatile room that needs calming from a source no one can point to. Quiet-05 stabilizes the environment through guidance that never announces itself.

nodes.label: QUIET-06
nodes.function_definition: Quiet (Exerts subtle, decisive influence)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy to withdraw influence completely, with nothing left to discover later. Quiet-06 dissolves the involvement so thoroughly there's no trace it was ever there.

nodes.label: QUIET-07
nodes.function_definition: Quiet (Exerts subtle, decisive influence)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy across several quiet actors who all need to move together without any visible coordination. Quiet-07 is the unspoken cue that puts them all in motion on the same beat.

nodes.label: QUIET-08
nodes.function_definition: Quiet (Exerts subtle, decisive influence)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy to make a hidden influence do more work than its size should allow. Quiet-08 is the whisper that reshapes outcomes far past where it was spoken.

nodes.label: QUIET-09
nodes.function_definition: Quiet (Exerts subtle, decisive influence)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy for the action that has to happen and also has to never be attributed. Quiet-09 conceals decisive intervention behind a posture of complete neutrality.

nodes.label: QUIET-10
nodes.function_definition: Quiet (Exerts subtle, decisive influence)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy at the single moment when staying hidden costs more than being seen. Quiet-10 reveals the subtle hand only when it will land hardest.

nodes.label: VECTOR-01
nodes.function_definition: Vector (Pushes momentum forward)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy to get a stalled effort moving from a dead stop. Vector-01 is pure ignition — the first push before there's any momentum to build on.

nodes.label: VECTOR-02
nodes.function_definition: Vector (Pushes momentum forward)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy when early momentum is real but fragile. Vector-02 protects the forward motion from the friction trying to slow it back down.

nodes.label: VECTOR-03
nodes.function_definition: Vector (Pushes momentum forward)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy when momentum is strong but pointed at the wrong target. Vector-03 redirects existing drive without losing the speed already built up.

nodes.label: VECTOR-04
nodes.function_definition: Vector (Pushes momentum forward)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy against resistance a normal push won't clear. Vector-04 forces a breakthrough by adding more force than the obstacle was built to survive.

nodes.label: VECTOR-05
nodes.function_definition: Vector (Pushes momentum forward)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy once momentum is established and needs to be maintained, not increased. Vector-05 keeps the pace sustainable over distance instead of burning out early.

nodes.label: VECTOR-06
nodes.function_definition: Vector (Pushes momentum forward)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy to bring motion to a controlled stop instead of an abrupt one. Vector-06 lets momentum wind down on schedule, without a collision.

nodes.label: VECTOR-07
nodes.function_definition: Vector (Pushes momentum forward)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy across multiple moving parts that need to arrive together. Vector-07 synchronizes independent momentum into one coordinated advance.

nodes.label: VECTOR-08
nodes.function_definition: Vector (Pushes momentum forward)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy when good momentum needs to become decisive momentum. Vector-08 accelerates an existing push until the outcome is no longer in question.

nodes.label: VECTOR-09
nodes.function_definition: Vector (Pushes momentum forward)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy when forward pressure needs to be applied without anyone identifying where it's coming from. Vector-09 keeps the push behind a neutral, uninvolved front.

nodes.label: VECTOR-10
nodes.function_definition: Vector (Pushes momentum forward)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy to make momentum impossible to ignore or downplay. Vector-10 puts visible speed on display as a signal that the decision has already been made.

nodes.label: PIVOT-01
nodes.function_definition: Pivot (Changes the direction of an outcome)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy at the first sign that the current direction won't hold. Pivot-01 is the earliest possible turn, before the cost of changing course goes up.

nodes.label: PIVOT-02
nodes.function_definition: Pivot (Changes the direction of an outcome)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy right after a turn, while the new direction is still vulnerable to being walked back. Pivot-02 locks in the angle before old momentum can reclaim it.

nodes.label: PIVOT-03
nodes.function_definition: Pivot (Changes the direction of an outcome)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy when the first pivot wasn't quite right. Pivot-03 is the correction that gets the turn onto its actual best line.

nodes.label: PIVOT-04
nodes.function_definition: Pivot (Changes the direction of an outcome)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy when a partial pivot won't force the adaptation the moment requires. Pivot-04 makes the turn sharp enough that no one can pretend nothing changed.

nodes.label: PIVOT-05
nodes.function_definition: Pivot (Changes the direction of an outcome)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy once the new direction is set and needs to become the default, not a detour. Pivot-05 stabilizes the turn until it's just the direction things go now.

nodes.label: PIVOT-06
nodes.function_definition: Pivot (Changes the direction of an outcome)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy to fully retire the old direction so it can't quietly resurface. Pivot-06 dissolves the previous course completely rather than leaving it as a fallback.

nodes.label: PIVOT-07
nodes.function_definition: Pivot (Changes the direction of an outcome)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy across a group that all needs to turn at once or risk scattering. Pivot-07 synchronizes the change of direction so no one turns early or late.

nodes.label: PIVOT-08
nodes.function_definition: Pivot (Changes the direction of an outcome)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy to make a turn happen faster than the situation would normally allow. Pivot-08 accelerates the transition once the direction is already decided.

nodes.label: PIVOT-09
nodes.function_definition: Pivot (Changes the direction of an outcome)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy when a shift needs to be prepared quietly before it's executed. Pivot-09 conceals the coming turn until the timing is exactly right.

nodes.label: PIVOT-10
nodes.function_definition: Pivot (Changes the direction of an outcome)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy to make a change of direction unmistakable to everyone downstream. Pivot-10 reveals the shift as the new definition of the situation, not a temporary detour.

nodes.label: DRAFT-01
nodes.function_definition: Draft (Pulls others along in its wake)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy to get a group moving that hasn't committed to moving yet. Draft-01 is the first pull that turns bystanders into followers before they've decided to be either.

nodes.label: DRAFT-02
nodes.function_definition: Draft (Pulls others along in its wake)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy when a group is following but might peel off under strain. Draft-02 reinforces the pull so momentum doesn't scatter the moment it gets difficult.

nodes.label: DRAFT-03
nodes.function_definition: Draft (Pulls others along in its wake)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy when the group is moving, but toward the wrong outcome. Draft-03 redirects collective momentum without breaking the formation carrying it.

nodes.label: DRAFT-04
nodes.function_definition: Draft (Pulls others along in its wake)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy against real resistance to being led. Draft-04 pulls hard enough that reluctance stops being a viable option for the group.

nodes.label: DRAFT-05
nodes.function_definition: Draft (Pulls others along in its wake)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy to keep a group moving as one body instead of drifting apart mid-effort. Draft-05 stabilizes formation behind the lead when the group's own cohesion starts to slip.

nodes.label: DRAFT-06
nodes.function_definition: Draft (Pulls others along in its wake)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy once a group is ready to operate without being pulled anymore. Draft-06 releases them to move independently, on purpose, rather than staying dependent.

nodes.label: DRAFT-07
nodes.function_definition: Draft (Pulls others along in its wake)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy across a group that needs to move as a single unit, not a loose crowd. Draft-07 synchronizes everyone's motion into one unified flow behind the lead.

nodes.label: DRAFT-08
nodes.function_definition: Draft (Pulls others along in its wake)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy to convert steady following into accelerated collective progress. Draft-08 amplifies the pull so the whole group moves faster than any one of them would alone.

nodes.label: DRAFT-09
nodes.function_definition: Draft (Pulls others along in its wake)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy when a group needs to be led without feeling led. Draft-09 conceals the pull so completely that the group believes the direction was their own idea.

nodes.label: DRAFT-10
nodes.function_definition: Draft (Pulls others along in its wake)
nodes.actionable_statement: Deploy when it's time for the group to know who's actually been guiding them. Draft-10 reveals the pull openly, establishing leadership on the record instead of behind it.
